FIXED (ASTRAL P1): Pluto +0.162° at 1988-06-15 — root cause was a frame mismatch, not the ch.37 transcription: ch.37 output is J2000-referred (PyMeeus Pluto.geocentric_position converts it with J2000 obliquity and Sun J2000 coordinates) while VSOP87D, the Sun and the house frame are date-referred.
